title: Jamaican Pork Skewers
description: Grilled Jamaican pork skewers with a sweet and spicy flavor, perfect for a summer evening. This recipe is a fusion of Caribbean and American flavors.

ingredients.name: pork shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.notes: You can also use pork loin or pork belly

ingredients.name: Jamaican jerk seasoning
ingredients.notes: You can also use a combination of allspice, thyme, and scotch bonnet peppers

ingredients.name: ketchup
ingredients.notes: You can also use honey or brown sugar

ingredients.name: brown sugar
ingredients.notes: You can also use honey or maple syrup

ingredients.name: soy sauce
ingredients.notes: You can also use tamari or coconut aminos

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.notes: You can also use coconut oil or avocado oil

ingredients.name: skewers
ingredients.notes: You can also use bamboo skewers or metal skewers

instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together jerk seasoning, ketchup, brown sugar, soy sauce, and olive oil.
2. Add the pork cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
3. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
4. Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
5. Thread the marinated pork cubes onto the skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
6. Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
7. Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes per side, or until the pork is cooked through.
8. Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
9. Serve the Jamaican pork skewers hot, garnished with cilantro or scallions if desired.
